source: Legion of Mary (Concilium Legionis Mariae and US senatus sites)
finding: No national list of praesidia. legionofmary.ie (Concilium, Dublin) publishes no unit directory; legionofmary.org now serves unrelated (gambling) content and is not used. US senatus/regia sites publish contact forms, not structured praesidium lists. Skipped as instructed; parish sites and bulletins remain the source for Legion of Mary groups.
